name: What is the initial process for engaging AKN Design Group for insurance restoration coordination?

mainEntity.name: What is the initial process for engaging AKN Design Group for insurance restoration coordination?

acceptedAnswer.text: The initial process for engaging AKN Design Group for insurance restoration coordination begins with a consultation where we discuss the damage, your insurance claim status, and your vision for the restoration. Our team will assess the scope of work required and provide an upfront estimate. This comprehensive approach allows us to align our expertise with your specific needs and the requirements of your insurance policy. We then guide you through the managed process, from design planning and material selection to permit coordination and construction, ensuring clear communication throughout.
